lore.intro:
Hydroponics. The torus keeps the greens
alive. The greens are dying in a spiral.

terminals.text:
BOTANY NOTE
The cucumbers grow clockwise here.
In the seed manual they grow counterclockwise.
Same seeds. Same water.
I stopped writing this up.

INVENTORY
2x fertilizer drum — MISSING.
Found both drums in the room I was standing in.
Behind me. I had checked behind me.

DIRECTIVE 0007 — MIRIAD PRIME
RE: survey of gravitational anomaly,
Track Quanta-118093

RETRIEVAL SUPERSEDES SURVEY.

[appended, local, unsigned]
Four months of careful science, inverted overnight
by three words. We cut the aperture Tuesday.
God help whoever reads this log in order.

FEEDER SCHEDULE, SECTOR 5
0400 nutrient, 0900 mist, 1400 nutrient,
1900 mist, 0000 dark cycle.
The dying trays spiral inward, sunwise.
The healthy trays spiral the other way.
Botany says plants do not have a 'way'.

SURVEY LOG — WEEK SIXTEEN
Nutrient uptake within tolerance. Torus rotation
nominal. Track Quanta-118093's gravitational
signature remains the whole of this posting's
interest, and it has not changed in sixteen weeks.
Request denied: additional survey time. Reason
given: 'the anomaly does not need more looking
at. It needs a name.' We have not been told what
name.

BENCH TAG, SECTOR ONE
Control group. No treatment applied. For
comparison only. Yield tracked weekly, entered by
hand because the automatic logger keeps entering
yields for a sector two rows over. Someone keeps
correcting the logger. The correction keeps
needing to happen again.

GARDEN AIRLOCK — ENTRY PROCEDURE
The lock will not cycle on a spent scrubber.
Fresh cartridges are racked at the end cap,
sector six, past the feeders. Slot the
cartridge, wait for the green, return the spent
unit to the rack. Do not prop the inner door.
Not after last time.

SHIPPING TAG, ZIP-TIED TO A FERTILIZER DRUM
Contents: fertilizer, 1 of 2.
Second tag, zip-tied to the same drum, underneath
the first:
Contents: fertilizer, 1 of 2.
Both tags are dated the same day. Neither one is
wrong.
